summary_1line: Dhaumya instructs the Pandavas on proper conduct in a royal court before they journey toward Virata’s city and plan to hide their weapons for incognito exile.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna lifts Draupadi like the leader of a herd of elephants and carries her through the dark forest toward the distant city of Virata.
The Pandavas stand beneath a huge, twisted Sami tree near a lonely cemetery as Arjuna prepares to hide the mighty Gandiva among its branches.
Dhaumya performs sacred fire rituals at night, flames rising as the Pandavas circle the fires before setting out into exile.
